name: Opportunistic Education
summary: Rexxie Copperclutch asks you to fetch a tome from Dalaran’s library while its mages are occupied. She hopes to sell the book and share the profit with you.

sections.title: A Book for Rexxie
sections.body: Rexxie Copperclutch, near the sewer entrance, sees a chance to profit from Dalaran’s library. While its mages are occupied, she asks you to bring her the tome called Founding of Dalaran. She offers to split whatever it sells for.

sections.title: The Book’s Worth
sections.body: Rexxie judges the book you bring back to be worth little. She considers disguising it with gold spray and claiming it belonged to an archmage.

faq.q: Who is asking for the book?
faq.answer: Rexxie Copperclutch, near Dalaran’s sewer entrance, asks you to bring her a tome from the city’s library.
Rexxie asks for Founding of Dalaran.

faq.q: Why does Rexxie want the tome?
faq.answer: Rexxie hopes to sell the tome and share the profit with you.

faq.q: Where is the book supposed to come from?
faq.answer: Rexxie asks you to find Founding of Dalaran in the City of Dalaran.

faq.q: What is happening with Dalaran’s mages?
faq.answer: Rexxie says the mages are occupied while she asks you to look for a book.

faq.q: What does Rexxie think of the book you bring?
faq.answer: Rexxie judges the book to be worth little and considers spraying it with gold to make it seem valuable.

angles.text: As an undead, Rexxie calls you like-minded and welcomes you into her scheme.
